scenarios.text_scenario: You are watching a lecture recording and one idea keeps going over your head.
examples: Lecture mein ye baat samajh nahi aayi
Ise thoda aur kholke bataiye
Poori tarah clear nahi hua ye point

scenarios.text_scenario: Your younger sibling asked you a question and you realise you cannot explain it yourself.
examples: Bhai ne pucha, mujhe khud nahi pata
Isko aasan tarike se batao
Bachhe ko kaise samjhaun ye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are reading ahead in the textbook and hit an idea the book assumes you already know.
examples: Book maan ke chal rahi hai, mujhe nahi pata
Iske peeche ka logic kya hai?
Ye kaam kaise karta hai andar se?

scenarios.text_scenario: You have been on the same question for twenty minutes and cannot move forward.
examples: Bees minute se atka hoon isi pe
Aage badh hi nahi pa raha
Iska hal nikaal ke dikhao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are practising past-year papers and one question has no solution given.
examples: Purane paper ka sawaal hai, answer nahi hai
Iska hal kaise nikalta hai?
Ye wala kar ke batao poora

scenarios.text_scenario: A word appeared in your exam syllabus that you have never seen before.
examples: Syllabus mein naya shabd hai, arth batao
Ye kis cheez ko kehte hain?
Iska sahi arth kya hota hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: Two terms sound similar and you want to know exactly what one of them means.
examples: Dono ek jaise lagte hain, farak batao
Iska exact meaning kya hai?
Theek theek kya kehlata hai ye?

scenarios.text_scenario: The definition made sense but you cannot picture where it applies.
examples: Kahan istemal hota hai ye batao
Kaise dikhta hai practically?
Kisi cheez se jodkar dikhao

scenarios.text_scenario: You must present in class and want illustrations to include.
examples: Presentation ke liye kuch cases chahiye
Do teen aur dikhao is tarah ke
Class mein kya bataun, kuch batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are studying with a friend and want to compete on who knows more.
examples: Dost ke saath compete karna hai, sawaal pucho
Mushkil wale puchna shuru karo
Dekhte hain kitna aata hai mujhe

scenarios.text_scenario: You have ten minutes free before class and want rapid-fire practice.
examples: Das minute hain, tez tez pucho
Jaldi jaldi sawaal daago
Rapid fire round karo mera

scenarios.text_scenario: You are filling a form that is entirely in English and one line confuses you.
examples: Form ki ye line samajh nahi aa rahi
Isko apni bhasha mein badlo
Ye likha kya hai, batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to reply to a message but cannot phrase it in the other language.
examples: Jawab dena hai, shabd nahi mil rahe
Isko dusri bhasha mein likho
Ye baat wahan kaise kahenge?

scenarios.text_scenario: You have three subjects to revise and only one week left.
examples: Teen subject hain, ek hafta bacha
Kaunsa pehle padhu batao
Time kaise baantu subjects mein?

scenarios.text_scenario: You keep starting and abandoning your revision and want a routine that sticks.
examples: Shuru karta hoon phir chhod deta hoon
Ek pakka routine bana do
Roz ka target set karo mera

scenarios.text_scenario: You have submitted nothing and the deadline is tonight.
examples: Aaj raat tak jama karna hai, kuch nahi hua
Deadline sar pe hai, madad karo
Jaldi se ye kaam nipta do

scenarios.text_scenario: You have written half of it and are unsure whether the rest is going the right way.
examples: Aadha likh liya, aage kya likhu?
Sahi disha mein ja raha hoon kya?
Baaki hissa kaise poora karu?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are starting a brand new subject next semester and want something to begin with.
examples: Naya vishay shuru kar raha hoon, kahan se padhu?
Shuruaat ke liye kya theek rahega?
Beginner ke liye kuch bataiye

scenarios.text_scenario: The material you have is too difficult and you want something simpler.
examples: Jo hai wo bahut kathin hai, aasan kuch do
Simple bhasha wala kuch bataiye
Isse halka kuch milega padhne ko?

scenarios.text_scenario: You and a classmate got different answers to the same question.
examples: Dost ka alag aaya, kiska sahi hai?
Dono mein se kaunsa theek hai?
Mera wala galat to nahi?

scenarios.text_scenario: You solved it quickly and it felt too easy, so you doubt yourself.
examples: Bahut jaldi ho gaya, shak ho raha hai
Itna aasan kaise ho sakta hai, dekho
Ek baar dobara jaanch lo

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker talks about something personal with no learning request.
examples: Bhookh lag rahi hai bahut
Kal ghumne jaana hai
Bahut garmi ho rahi aaj

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something from another domain — banking, travel, or assistant.
examples: Kiraya transfer kar do
Seat khali hai kya dekho
Light bujha do kamre ki

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker responds with hesitation or an incomplete thought.
examples: Wo kya bolte hain use
Ruko ruko ek second
Nahi kuch khaas nahi
